newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN RUPIAH OFF HISTORIC LOW BUT VOLATILE.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN RUPIAH OFF HISTORIC LOW BUT VOLATILE.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah recovered slightly against the dollar in early trading on Wednesday after sliding to a historic low of 2,679, dealers said.
Spot rupiah plunged to a new low of 2,679 at 0200 GMT from an opening of 2,674.0/76.0 before recovering slightly to 2,670.0/75.0 at 0915 GMT.

"It's the contagion effect which pushes the rupiah lower. The Singapore dollar has also touched a new low," one local bank dealer said. The dealer said comments by a leading economist in a daily newspaper suggesting the central bank not intervene added to the pressure on the local currency.
Sjahrir, an economist and owner of a brokerage firm, was quoted in the Kompas daily as saying the market would ultimately decide a fair value for the rupiah.

"According to me, just let the rupiah fall to 2,700 or 2,800. The central bank does not have to do anything. Once they (speculators) realise the central bank hasn't done anything, the dollar is already overvalued," Sjahrir was quoted as saying.
The previous low of the rupiah was 2,665 on July 21.
Dealers said swaps rose also across the board. One-week swap was at 5.5/6.0 and six-month at 135/142 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,378/2,682 but raised the conversion band to 2,616/2,664 on Tuesday from 2,588/2,636 on Monday.
